title: Last Warm Loaf
logline: On a stormy closing night, a bakery owner and a soaked night courier share one quiet kindness before the lights go out.
plot: Rain lashes a corner bakery as Mira flips the OPEN sign to CLOSED. Outside, Theo, a night courier, shields a crumpled delivery ticket and stares at the dark doorway. Mira notices him through the glass, unlocks the door, and hands him the last warm loaf wrapped in paper. They stand in the golden doorway while rain beads on Theo's jacket. He nods once, tucks the bread under his arm, and steps back into the storm. Mira watches him go, then dims the lights.

locations.name: Corner bakery at night
locations.description: A small street-corner bakery with warm interior light spilling onto wet pavement during a heavy rainstorm.

state.name: Storm closing
state.lookDescription: Narrow brick-front bakery with a large front window and glass door. Warm amber interior light on wooden shelves of leftover loaves, a metal cooling rack, chalk menu board half erased. Outside: glossy wet asphalt, neon reflections in puddles, rain streaks on glass, a CLOSED sign hanging crooked, steam fogging the lower panes.

shots.title: Closed for the night
shots.prompt: Night rain on a corner bakery, warm amber light glowing through a large front window, Mira in a navy flour-dusted apron reaching up to flip a hanging CLOSED sign, wet brick facade and puddles reflecting neon, quiet and cinematic.
shots.motionPrompt: Slow push toward the bakery window as rain streaks the glass, Mira's hand turns the CLOSED sign, warm interior light holds steady against the storm.

shots.title: Courier in the rain
shots.prompt: Theo stands alone on wet pavement outside the bakery doorway, olive green courier jacket dark with rain, reflective strips catching streetlight, messenger bag across his chest, crumpled ticket in his fist, rain falling hard around him.
shots.motionPrompt: Theo shifts his weight, rain beads and runs off his jacket, he glances from the ticket to the lit doorway, breath visible in the cold.

shots.title: Door unlocks
shots.prompt: From inside looking out through rain-beaded glass, Mira unlocks the bakery door and opens it a crack, golden light spilling onto Theo's soaked silhouette on the sidewalk, steam rising where warm air meets cold rain.
shots.motionPrompt: The door swings open, warm light floods the wet sidewalk, Theo looks up startled as Mira appears in the doorway holding a paper-wrapped loaf.

shots.title: The last loaf
shots.prompt: Close two-shot in the bakery doorway, Mira offering a paper-wrapped warm loaf with both hands, Theo accepting it carefully, rain glittering behind them, soft golden key light on their faces, quiet gratitude in the frame.
shots.motionPrompt: Mira extends the wrapped loaf, Theo takes it with both hands, a small nod passes between them, steam rises faintly from the paper in the cold air.

shots.title: Into the storm
shots.prompt: Wide night shot of the bakery doorway as Theo tucks the loaf under his arm and steps back into heavy rain, Mira standing in the golden rectangle of light watching him leave, empty wet street stretching behind him.
shots.motionPrompt: Theo turns and walks into the rain with the loaf sheltered under his arm, Mira remains in the doorway, then the bakery lights dim as he disappears down the glistening street.
